# The first review asks for changes. The revise step adds the file notes/6.md, which belongs to no sub-question (the scope wrote two).
# The check exits with code 2 on the first look, so the item stops at the check at once and does not repeat the pass. No second review runs.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start

example research/workflow.star
example research/project.star config/projects/research.star
example research/prompts/scope.md
example research/prompts/research.md
example research/prompts/review.md
example research/prompts/revise.md
example research/prompts/conclude.md
example research/tools/check.sh
example research/tools/report.sh
fakeclaude
serve

env RESEARCH_TOOLS=$WORK/research/tools
env RESEARCH_OUT=$WORK/out

exec obeereal item add research weigh-ab --title 'Compare A and B' --body-file body.txt

exitcode 1 obeereal run weigh-ab research --workflow research/workflow.star
stdout 'a notes file has no sub-question: notes/6\.md'

cmp calls.log expected-calls.log
! exists out/weigh-ab.md
! exists out/weigh-ab-unreviewed.md
